Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| **Thai Orchid** | 1400 W. 19th St., Chicago | Provides a separate vegetarian menu with options like tofu pad see ew and vegetable spring rolls. |
| **Mango Tree** | 1200 W. 18th St., Chicago | Has a range of vegetarian curries and noodle dishes; also offers vegan options. |
| **Khao San Road** | 1700 W. 18th St., Chicago | Features a vegetarian menu with dishes such as vegetable khao soi and tofu satay. |
